Shri Justice
Achal Kumar Paliwal

On The 6 th Of February, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 5609 of 2025
 Vikram Valmik
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Ms. Pushpanjaly Dwivedi - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Vijay Kumar Pandey-- G.A. for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.The applicant is in custody since 23.11.2024 in connection with Crime No.445/2024 registered at P.S.- City Kotwali District Damoh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366-A,
376(2)(N) of IPC and Sections 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.

3.Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in jail since 23.11.2024.
No injury has been found on the person of the prosecutrix.
After referring to statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, it is a case of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:5832 2 MCRC-5609-2025 consensual relationship.
Prosecutrix left her house on her own.
It is urged that from the statement of prosecutrix, it is evident that she had gone along with applicant at various places and she did not seek any help of anyone.

Therefore,
it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this bail application stands allowed.

7.It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9.Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to appellant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
